anjvryss: Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss arrived with the Day 8 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S16 with the rations. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss ate while listening to the revised orders. After what happened at the Chalk Pits, Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.
arthur.ds999: Wendel "Hollow" Arthur arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Wendel "Hollow" Arthur had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Viktor Ronne was badly wounded. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home reached Wendel "Hollow" Arthur before dusk. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur read it twice and slept a little easier.
brycetom03: "You're late," said the corporal when Marek Brycetom arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F15, Marek Brycetom listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.
filipentav: Gustav Filipentav reached R-C2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Gustav Filipentav fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Norbert Littlesaint was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gustav Filipentav helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. A letter from home found Gustav Filipentav before the night shift. Gustav Filipentav folded it small and kept it close.
freddie55133: Bram Freddie stepped off the supply cart at R-S8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Bram Freddie found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Bram Freddie cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Bram Freddie keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a pressed cornflower. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Bram Freddie read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S8, Bram Freddie listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
gavinlordofpugs: Henrik Gavinlordofp introduced himself as a lamplighter from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A sniper's bullet hit Henrik Gavinlordofp at R-F5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).
The surgeon worked on Henrik Gavinlordofp until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
Another member of the House of Gavinlordofp reached the line: Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp. He asked where Henrik Gavinlordofp had slept, then chose a different corner.

Dawn watch. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Benedikt Calderthebal, grazed. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
The trench wall shook against Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp moved to a new hide at R-F5 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver, grazed.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F5. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21).
Hugo Gavinlordofp had heard about Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp's courage. At R-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
its.hop_: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Bones" Hop arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram "Bones" Hop found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Bram "Bones" Hop before dusk. Bram "Bones" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier. Bram "Bones" Hop became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Bram "Bones" Hop was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F4 with the rations. Bram "Bones" Hop ate while listening to the revised orders.

Bram "Bones" Hop was hit through the chest at S-F4. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Bram "Bones" Hop fell at S-F4 and never moved again. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233).

Leopold "Saint" Hop took the same post at S-F4 where Bram "Bones" Hop stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Leopold "Saint" Hop left the work of a sniper to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Leopold "Saint" Hop spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. A letter from home reached Leopold "Saint" Hop before dusk. Leopold "Saint" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Saint" Hop had Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony in the sights at Lantern Hill for a long second. Felix "Parson" Brendanm was lighting a pipe. Leopold "Saint" Hop let the match burn all the way down.

The gun at S-F4 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo, grazed. Leopold "Saint" Hop fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Lucien Zag was grazed. A letter from home reached Leopold "Saint" Hop before dusk. Leopold "Saint" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Saint" Hop was on watch at S-F4 when the night raid hit. The men found Leopold "Saint" Hop at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Jonas Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike).

Zeno Hop joined S-F4 under the shadow of Leopold "Saint" Hop's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. After what happened at the Hanging Bridge, Zeno Hop asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.
le.mrsh_: Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh reached R-F16 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh has learnt to recognise the ration cart by its squeaking wheel. A different squeak caused considerable disappointment this afternoon. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
A parcel came for Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh and Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F16, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The parcel's address was smudged. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Dietrich Dilloncoll was grazed.
Across from R-F16, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh saw it. Bastian Ebrrrvole was grazed.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.
sovi_tendmother: Ivo "Brick" Tendmother, a glassblower from Kesselby, was sent forward on Day 8 to fill a gap in R-S1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Someone asked Ivo "Brick" Tendmother to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S1 with the rations. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother ate while listening to the revised orders.
thejournal06: On Day 10, Arno Thejournal arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
wardaddy_studios: At the depot, Leopold "Mud" Studios had practised answering to his name. At S-R13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Leopold "Mud" Studios across the shin at S-R13. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Leopold "Mud" Studios could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
wicker_jug: The quartermaster asked Jonas "Spark" Jug to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Jonas "Spark" Jug came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F14 with the rations. Jonas "Spark" Jug ate while listening to the revised orders.
